description: -55℃~+155℃ 1.8Ω 125mW 150V Thick Film Resistor ±250ppm/℃ ±5% 0805 Chip Resistor - Surface Mount ROHS
compatibility_notes: Added a missing generic 0805 1.8 ohm resistor ID. The FH datasheet rates the package at 1/8 W and 150 V limiting element voltage; JLC and same-code LCSC both list 125 mW, 150 V, ±5%, and ±250 ppm/°C. No matching generic ID or prior reviewed preference exists.
evidence_notes: Live JLC page at https://jlcpcb.com/partdetail/1649-RS05L1R8JT/C1297 confirms Extended class, FH, exact MPN, C1297, 0805, specs and MOQ/reel/stock. Same-code LCSC product page https://www.lcsc.com/product-detail/C1297.html confirms maker, MPN, C-code, package, specs and links its C1297 datasheet. The JLC-linked C1297 PDF was downloaded through the browser; pages 1–3 identify FH thick-film chip resistors and confirm 0805 1/8 W, 150 V limiting voltage, -55 to +155 °C, and ±200 or ±250 ppm/°C for 1 Ω to below 10 Ω at ±5%.
Full visible product-page text saved from the interactive browser in kicad_agents/jlc_house_parts/browser_staging/C1297.json.
